status.title: Current status
status.freeHint: Buy Pro to keep practicing score calculation with no daily limit.
status.lifetimeHint: You can use the Pro features available at the time of purchase for good.
status.passHint: When it expires, you go back to the free plan.
status.grantedHint: A Pro benefit granted by the operator. It is kept separate from benefits you purchased.

offers.title: Choose a plan
offers.shared: Both give the same Pro features. No automatic renewal.
offers.sharedLifetimeOnly: Pay once to use the Pro features. No automatic renewal.
offers.lifetimeScope: The lifetime purchase does not include features added in the future.

lifetime.title: Lifetime
lifetime.description: Pay once and use the features available at purchase with no expiry

offers.priceUnavailable: Please check the price on the purchase screen

alreadyActive: You already have an active purchase, so you cannot buy more. You can buy a pass again after it expires.
alreadyActiveLifetimeOnly: You already have an active purchase, so you cannot buy more. If you have a 30-day pass, you can buy the lifetime purchase after it expires.

notes.title: Before you buy
notes.noAutoRenew: Neither the 30-day pass nor the lifetime purchase renews automatically.
notes.noAutoRenewLifetimeOnly: The lifetime purchase does not renew automatically.
notes.pass: When the 30-day pass expires, you go back to the free plan. You cannot buy more while it is active, but you can buy it again after it expires.
notes.snapshot: Your purchase covers the Pro benefits at the time you buy. Even if the benefits change later, what you bought stays the same.
notes.noRefund: Refund requests are handled by Apple. We cannot issue refunds directly.
notes.deletion: If you delete your account, your purchase records are deleted and no refund is given.
notes.appleBilling: Payment is processed through the App Store. Apple sends the receipt.

restore.title: Restore Purchases
restore.hint: Use this if you bought the lifetime purchase on another device or reinstalled the app. A 30-day pass comes back when you log in.
restore.hintLifetimeOnly: Use this if you bought the lifetime purchase on another device or reinstalled the app.

purchaseRecorded: Your purchase has been recorded. Thank you!
purchaseFailed: Could not complete the purchase. Please try again later.
purchaseDeferred: Your purchase is waiting for approval. Pro becomes active once it is approved.
ownedByAnotherAccount: This purchase is recorded under a different account. Please log in with the account you used to buy it.
nothingToRestore: There were no purchases to restore.
restoreFailed: Could not restore your purchases. Please check your connection and try again.
